summary: Read and search your saved Readeck articles. Needs an account.
release_notes: Commands to run on your computer are set on a grey panel in a fixed-width face and break only at spaces. Headings are a step smaller and hints a step larger.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Readeck must be reachable over HTTPS.
In Readeck, create an API token that can read and update bookmarks (Settings, API tokens).
Connect Readeck from your computer. It asks for the server and the token, checks them, and saves both on the reader while Cobalt runs. Open Readeck, or tap Check again if it is already open.
Articles you open are kept on the reader, so they read the same without Wi-Fi.
